question: What are the best alternatives to the ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station?
query: best alternatives ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station 2026 comparison Belkin Anker UGREEN

judge.why: The answer recommends UGREEN first and cites ESR, UGREEN, SKEGIC, Walmart, Target and Adorama, with no dealectric.com source and none of our products among the alternatives.

replays.text:
Based on the 12 pages you provided, **the UGREEN Nexode 100W GaN with 15W MagSafe Charger Station is the strongest direct alternative** to the ESR 100W 6-in-1. However, several other options are better depending on whether you prioritize Apple Watch charging, portability, or fewer cables.

## Top alternatives

  <row align="start" gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="UGREEN Nexode 100W GaN 15W MagSafe charging station desktop stand" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="112px"/>
    <box flex="1">
      **1. UGREEN Nexode 100W GaN with 15W MagSafe**

      <badge color="success">Best overall alternative</badge>

      Closest match to ESR in power and functionality. Offers 100W GaN power, 15W MagSafe, a sturdy stand, and additional USB ports.

      **Trade-off:** No built-in Apple Watch charger.
      
      [iMore review](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)
    </box>
  </row>
  <divider/>
  <row align="start" gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="Anker 737 MagGo Charger 3 in 1 station iPhone Apple Watch AirPods" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="112px"/>
    <box flex="1">
      **2. Anker 737 MagGo Charger (3-in-1 Station)**

      **Best for Apple ecosystem users**

      Charges iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods together with 15W MagSafe. Great for a dedicated desk or nightstand.

      **Trade-off:** Bulky and doesn't provide the ESR's 100W multiport laptop-charging versatility.

      [iMore recommendations](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
    </box>
  </row>
  <divider/>
  <row align="start" gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="Belkin BoostCharge Pro 3 in 1 MagSafe charging stand white" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="112px"/>
    <box flex="1">
      **3. Belkin BoostCharge Pro 3-in-1**

      **Best premium Apple-focused stand**

      Elegant design, MagSafe charging, and a dedicated Apple Watch charger. A strong choice for a polished desk setup.

      **Trade-off:** Less versatile for charging a MacBook and other wired devices.

      [iMore review roundup](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
    </box>
  </row>
  <divider/>
  <row align="start" gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station Foldable 3 in 1 Qi2 travel charger" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="112px"/>
    <box flex="1">
      **4. Anker MagGo Foldable 3-in-1**

      **Best for travel**

      Compact, foldable, and capable of charging your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Convenient for packing and traveling.

      **Trade-off:** Not a 100W wired charging hub like the ESR.

      [Macworld review roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668980/best-magsafe-chargers.html)
    </box>
  </row>
  <divider/>
  <row align="start" gap={3}>
    <AsyncImage query="Anker 3 in 1 Cube MagSafe charger Apple Watch AirPods compact cube" aspectRatio="4:3" maxWidth="112px"/>
    <box flex="1">
      **5. Anker 3-in-1 Cube with MagSafe**

      **Best compact alternative**

      A small, foldable charging solution for iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Ideal if you want to reduce desk clutter.

      **Trade-off:** Does not offer the ESR's 100W wired power delivery.

      [iMore comparison](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)
    </box>
  </row>
</box>

## Quick comparison

| Charger | iPhone | Apple Watch | AirPods | 100W wired charging |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **ESR 100W 6-in-1** | MagSafe | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **UGREEN Nexode 100W** | 15W MagSafe | No | Via USB | Yes |
| **Anker 737 MagGo** | MagSafe | Yes | Yes | No |
| **Belkin BoostCharge Pro** | MagSafe | Yes | Yes | No |
| **Anker MagGo Foldable** | MagSafe | Yes | Yes | No |
| **Anker 3-in-1 Cube** | MagSafe | Yes | Yes | No |

## My recommendation

If you're looking for a true replacement for the ESR rather than just another wireless charging stand:

- **Choose UGREEN Nexode 100W** if laptop charging, power, and value matter most.
- **Choose Anker 737 MagGo** if charging all three Apple devices wirelessly is more important than wired 100W output.
- **Choose Belkin BoostCharge Pro** if premium design and Apple Watch charging are your priorities.
- **Choose Anker MagGo Foldable** if you want one charger for home and travel.

**Bottom line:** UGREEN is the most compelling alternative in your list because it retains the ESR's central selling point — **100W wired power plus integrated MagSafe** — while costing less according to the iMore comparison.
